sentences.text: Donald McKinley Glover -LRB- -LSB- ˈɡlʌvər -RSB- born September 25 , 1983 -RRB- is an American actor , writer , producer , comedian , rapper , singer , and songwriter .
As a recording artist , he usually performs under the stage name Childish Gambino , and as a disc jockey , he performs under the name mcDJ .	stage name	stage name

He first came to attention for his work with Derrick Comedy and , with the help of Tina Fey , was hired at the age of 23 to become a writer for the NBC comedy series 30 Rock .	Derrick Comedy	Derrick Comedy	Tina Fey	Tina Fey	NBC	NBC	30 Rock	30 Rock
He later portrayed community college student Troy Barnes on the NBC sitcom Community .	NBC	NBC	Troy Barnes	Troy Barnes	Community	Community (TV series)
He currently stars in the FX series Atlanta , which he also created .	FX	FX (TV channel)	Atlanta	Atlanta (TV series)
He will appear in Spider-Man : Homecoming , and has been cast as the young Lando Calrissian in the upcoming , untitled standalone Han Solo Star Wars movie .	Lando Calrissian	Lando Calrissian
He will also provide the voice of Simba in a remake of the Disney film The Lion King .	film	film	Simba	Simba	The Lion King	The Lion King
After several self-released albums and mixtapes , Glover signed to Glassnote Records in 2011 .	Glassnote	Glassnote Records	Glassnote Records	Glassnote Records
He released his first album , Camp , on November 15 , 2011 to generally positive reviews .	Camp	Camp (album)
His second studio album , Because the Internet , was released on December 10 , 2013 .	Because the Internet	Because the Internet

Glover was nominated for two Grammy Awards in 2015 , Best Rap Album for Because the Internet and Best Rap Performance for his single `` 3005 '' .	Because the Internet	Because the Internet	Grammy Awards	Grammy Awards	3005	3005 (song)
